descriptors.R: nominee of the party of the administration in office since 1981; the sitting Vice President
descriptors.D: nominee of the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 1986 elections; a sitting Northeastern governor

compile_desc.R: the party of the administration in office since 1981
compile_desc.D: the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 1986 elections

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including a Libertarian and a New Alliance party nominee (answer "other").
never_name: Bush, Dukakis, Quayle, Bentsen, Reagan, Carter, Jackson, Hart, Kemp, Dole, Robertson, Ron Paul, Fulani or Horton

slice_sources.men: 1980 and 1990 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1988; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1988); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 1988 returns.
slice_sources.women: 1980 and 1990 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1988; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1988); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 1988 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 1980 and 1990 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1988; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1988); calibrated to the certified 1988 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 1980 and 1990 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1988; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 1988), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 1988 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 1980 and 1990 censuses (NHGIS) interpolated to November 1988; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the party out of the White House
the party out of the White House
